tagline: Operations and supply chain hires for the Midwest
intro: We recruit the people who keep freight moving: warehouse leaders, demand planners and transport managers for distributors, manufacturers and 3PLs across the Midwest.
audience: Distributors, manufacturers and third-party logistics operators in Illinois, Indiana, Wisconsin, Ohio and Michigan, hiring from shift supervisor up to director.
pricing_note: A percentage of first-year base salary, invoiced when your hire starts. Director searches are retained and billed in three parts.

services.title: Contingent search
services.description: Supervisor and manager roles on the warehouse floor and in the planning office. You pay a fee only when you hire someone we introduced.

services.title: Retained director search
services.description: A dedicated search for directors and heads of operations, with a map of who holds similar jobs in your region and a weekly shortlist call.

services.title: Peak season leadership
services.description: Shift leads and area managers hired in late summer, so your fourth quarter team is trained before the volume arrives.

services.title: Pay and market briefings
services.description: Salary ranges and candidate availability for one role in one location, written up before you open the requisition.

process.title: Brief
process.description: A half-hour call on the role, the site, the shift pattern and the pay range. We write the job brief and send it back for your sign-off.

process.title: Shortlist
process.description: We search, screen and interview, then send a short list of candidates with notes on each one and what they expect to earn.

process.title: Offer and start
process.description: We set up interviews, take references, handle the offer conversation and keep in touch with your new hire until their first shift.

proof.text: Filled two night-shift operations managers before peak season.
Their planners understood our ERP on day one.
Clear weekly updates, every role, every week.
